reviews.title: Better than expected
reviews.text: I’ve used Sun Express afew times now. I can’t understand the bad reviews. Good service for a economy budget airline. Fast efficient service, new plane and good smiley air stewardesses. Best thing is they offer extra luggage for a reasonable price and no hassle if your slightly over. Thank you Sun Express
reviews.author: riazm1

reviews.title: Destroyed luggage
reviews.text: They destroyed my luggage, and by saying destroyed I mean it has a big whole and is totaly broken and ripped. It is, or should I say it was made from a very hard material. Except for that it is mend in many places and corners. Ive never seen anything like that. What's better, I tried to report it on their website, but it turns out I can't because I'm not from Turkey. If you are not from Turkey, you have another partnering website you have to contact, which is even worse - after 2h of fighting with the report and screaming from frustration I finally finished, clicked "send", and got the information that there are technical difficulties and I should contact them some other way, another day. That's honestly tragic. Sunexpress, nothing with you works properly. Doubtfully will I ever fly with you again.
reviews.author: Antonina J

reviews.title: A very bad timing and horrible customer service.
reviews.text: The worst flight I’ve ever had!!! 30 minutes delay in the outbound flight from Antalya to Adana. And 8 hours and 30 minuted delays in the inbound flight from Gaziantep to Antalya… They haven’t informed us with the delays. We just arrived to the airport 2 hours before the flight to have this surprise. We tried to contact their Turkey call Center to complain about it..no response. We managed to reach their call Center in UK, who respond in a very cold way saying there nothing they can do and they hang up the phone in a very rude way..!!!!
reviews.author: Abdullah R

reviews.title: worst airline I’ve flew with.
reviews.text: Make ryanair look like Emirates. Both outbound and inbound flights the air hostesses looked completely lost and disinterested. Im 6 foot 3 and spent 5 hours crushed behind the seat in front, and no recline fitted on the seats, definitely the smallest legroom I have experienced and I fly on average twice a month for both business and pleasure. We sat for an hour on the taxiway in 35c with air hostesses walking up and down constantly counting passengers but didn't think to update the passengers on what was happening, oh and dont expect any updates from the cockpit about arrival time, temperatures, delays because they dont do that either. I wont fly with these again, what an absolute mess. They also didnt offer anyone online check in, but when reaching the check in desk at the airport they decided that they were going to charge everyone £5 per person to print the boarding pass. A line of 30 people took 2 hours to go down as every person who reached the front had the same argument and were told they weren't getting their boarding pass until the walked to the other-side of the terminal to the sun express help desk and paid the fine. The girl behind the check out was smirking when everyone was expressing their concerns which made everyone even more irritated. The only reason they get 2 star instead of 1 is because they are dirt cheap, but considering they are a joint venture of Lufthansa and turkish airlines you would expect them to maintain a certain level of service. Do not fly with these, pay a little bit more and go with jet2, tui or even ryanair for your package holidays.
reviews.author: Ryan B

reviews.title: the delay GOD
reviews.text: the delay coming out of Manchester was an hour the cabin crew was nice and hlepfull but they did not speek english
reviews.author: hotels and airlines reviews

reviews.title: DO NOT PRE BOOK AND PAY FOR SEATS ON THE PLANE AS THEY WILL GIVE YOUR SEATS TO ANYONE AND NOT REFUND YOU.
reviews.text: Absolute sham of an airline, if you pre book and pay for seats on the plane you will not get them, and you will not be refunded and it is impossible to get through to the airline.
reviews.author: Debbie H

reviews.title: Beware! If there are any issues they wont help!
reviews.text: No issues with the flight or service on board and the planes are half decent. But if you have an issue - forget it! Our suitcases arrived at manchester with all the clothes inside soiled. We didnt see any damage on suitcases. ( We believe this is due to the downpour at dalaman airport. They mustve left the suitcases on the tarmac. ) I have been using whatsapp and their website trying to resolve this its impossible. They say i needed a PNR report from the airport. Unless I had supersonic eyesight how was i to know there was any isue till i got home?! But they are too thick to understand this. All my clothes old and new ruined. Very very poor customer service. Will not use them again. AVOID !!
reviews.author: Sam B

reviews.title: Excellent no
reviews.text: Flew back from Antalya with Sun Express today and can't sing their praises enough. Efficient service at the airport, very friendly staff, small delay leaving of 20 mins ended up as only 5 minute delay arriving at Manchester. The flight crew were all very smartly dressed, friendly and helpful. So different to our flight out to Antalya with another airline. First time flying with Sun Express and not the last. Well done to everyone.
reviews.author: Sara K

reviews.title: No complaints!
reviews.text: Having read a lot of reviews we were quite worried about flying with Sunexpress, however we needn't have been. Both flights left on time (return landed half an hour early) , friendly staff, no problems with baggage drop or collection and fair prices on board the flight - we could pay in lira, sterling or on card. Staff were great with our 5 year old son and he was given a colouring activity book on our return flight. Seems a fair amount of negative reviews on here are down to the fault of the passenger eg less than 6 months on passport and entering incorrect passenger details which is their fault and not the airlines. Would recommend and would fly with them again. Thumbs up!
reviews.author: ODM2013

reviews.title: Really good experience
reviews.text: We were a bit concerned about all the bad reviews so was pleasantly surprised. Check in was chaotic at Manchester flight left on time, more legroom than Easyjet and Jet2. Plane was very clean and crew were very friendly. Drinks on board were very expensive but that was the only negative. For the people who complain about damaged luggage, its nothing to do with the airline its the baggage handlers. At Dalaman airport we saw numerous suitcases flying off the luggage cart loading s Jet2 flight.
reviews.author: Hogmail

reviews.title: Always late, never on time, horrible service
reviews.text: We flew from Hamburg to Antalya and then back. Both flights were late. Zero organization at gate, zero service on flight. I strongly recommend to avoid Sunexpress. It is by far the worst airline I flew with ever and I flew throughout the world. Airplanes are dirty and smell - both ways.
reviews.author: Galina H

reviews.title: Not as bad as I expected.
reviews.text: Flew return to Dalaman with family. Expected the worst reading previous reviews but was pleasantly surprised on my own experience. Flights were on time and leg room wasn't as bad as I expected.
reviews.author: Raj S

reviews.text: service on time Seat we’re bit poor and booking app was very slow Brokered my hard shell Suitcase Was happy it was new suits case we brought
reviews.author: Singh

reviews.title: Shocking company
reviews.text: The flight and the return is up there as the most uncomfortable of my life. Terrible seats and the in flight "snacks/drinks" were just overpriced garbage. I would never use this company again. We had special assistance for our son both ways which despite arranging with the airline prior to arrival we ended up sorting ourselves at check in both times. Avoid this company
reviews.author: Craig

reviews.title: Broken luggage 🧳
reviews.text: Bought 3 new suitcases all were badly scratched with the expensive one complete broken with a hole in No legroom I'm 5.0 so we struggled no where to put anything so by end of the flight it's just like a dumpster
reviews.author: Marie S

reviews.title: 2023 travelling with sun express
reviews.text: My self and my family travelled with sun express to Turkey in April, we had a brilliant experience with this air line, lots of reviews I read before travelling made me feel like we were going to have a bad experience but both our flights were in time and the staff were lovely, definitely travel with sun express again
reviews.author: Donna

reviews.title: MR
reviews.text: Worst Airline. They even charge you for water. The air crafts are old. They don’t even have TV monitors.
reviews.author: Ercan John S

reviews.title: Never use SunExpress services
reviews.text: 25/05/2023 in Warsaw was uncompetent staff. The staff does not know the rules of transportation of animals. Absolutely useless employees. Be prepared that you may not be allowed on the flight and you won't get any help or information.
reviews.author: aranten

reviews.title: These are the worst airline I have ever flown with in my life.
reviews.text: This has got to be the worst experience flying with an airline ever and I’m nearly 50 so had some bad times in the past with some poor airlines, but these just scrape the barrel. To cut a long story, I double booked and they kept my money and wouldnt refund one of the flights, even though they were both booked same flights, times and names. Then to add insult to injury, I asked about changing dates or names etc, they said that they would do it but wanted another £320, remember I have already paid £1000 for a £500 flight. Then it won’t let me check in online, so I go to the airport they want £9 extra for this. Then on my return the same thing happened I can’t check in and they only had extra leg room seats so I had to pay £50. The organisation at Antalya airport is shocking, I had to go to the desk pay the £50, there were numerous people going berserk with them, the organisation is disgraceful. I then stand in another queue for half an hour to get the boarding passes even though I didn’t want to put my bags through the bag drop. The seats have to have the thinnest padding I’ve ever known on a seat, rizla papers are thicker. We all go for the cheapest flight we can find but be warned I would pay a little extra than fly with these.
reviews.author: Honestyisthebestwa

reviews.title: Bad Service all round
reviews.text: Hi, My name is Damien Rojob Ali Khan. I was on a flight one of your airline Sun Express from izmir to Manchester on 1st October at 6.45 p.m. I was thrown out after being arrested in Manchester Airport. I have never been arrested in my entire life. I worked in Film and Music Industry for 25 years. I worked with Rhianna from 2005 to 2016. I wrote 70 number one songs including With Bruno Mars, Katie Perry, Eminem DrDe Pitbull Dizzy Rascal. I made Skyfall with Daniel Craig, Fast And The Furious 6 and 7, War Horse with Steven Spielberg. I was feeling stomach upset. I took medication before getting a flight. There was a man next to me and released gas. I was vomiting in the toilet then had one cigarette. I really don't understand Turkish. I saw a astray but I threw the bud in the toilet. Then one stew attendant yelled at me checked my pockets and my passport was taken from me. After landing 5 Police were waiting for me and was asked questions. They let me go because of my clean record. I have filled a Law Suit with Sun Express as i was humiliated. I know the Royal Family including HrH Prince Charles 3rd for 20 years. I hope I get compensated I intend to stop all Sun Express Airlines in England. Hope you response from my letter. Damien Rojob Ali Khan-OBE,Ekushoy Padok
reviews.author: Damien Rojob Ali Khan- OBE

reviews.title: Nightmare
reviews.text: Worst airline I've ever traveled with,there IT system is rubbish, wouldn't let us check in online but let us book seats , we was told we had to pay £9 to Swiss air for boarding passes because they said there site was working , we even tried at the airport and it still wouldn't let us check in, jokers,the queue was ridiculous on the way home , staff had really bad attitude and were unhelpful, hope tui aren't going to use these in future !
reviews.author: Nicholas H

reviews.title: No free online check in
reviews.text: On our way to Antalya on line check in didn't work. Today it worked, but no free check in, they count 10 euro.. no seat choice, no extra luggage.. It's a scam
reviews.author: Patricia L

reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.text: The booking agency made an error on the the surname of one of the passengers. I had to purchase a new ticket and got no refund from the previous ticket I had bought.
reviews.author: R A

reviews.title: Damaged baggage lost connection
reviews.text: They are responsible for my baggage or not I received like this, they didn’t give me my another boarding pass i had difficulty after that u can not imagine. For people like me who doesn’t know they sell what u need even water
reviews.author: camellia B

reviews.title: very poor
reviews.text: Check in was a joke, weigh your case then take it to a conveyor at the side of the check in desks. Flight delayed for one and a half hours going to Antalya. Trolley service was terrible with only red wine, white wine or jack daniels available. Prices on board for any food or drink were a bit on the high side even for the small amounts you could buy. they only took card payments on the way out but strangely took cash on the way back. Return flight was no better our check in queue was delayed for half an hour for one passenger who eventually did not check in at that point. frustrating to hold up so many people for one person, poor management. Return flight delayed for half an hour once we were seated and same overpriced items on the trolley service.
reviews.author: Derrick

reviews.title: A great experience
reviews.text: I was worried about booking this airline after reading lots of negative reviews, but the timing of the flight really suited me. I had to contact customer service before I travelled and they corrected a mistake I'd made with the booking name within 5 minutes at no charge. The flight left on time, seats were comfortable enough and staff friendly. No complaints at all NB. I didn't eat it but food selection on board was not appealing!
reviews.author: mcrachel

reviews.title: Extremeply disappointing and pathetic experience with 12 hour delay when all other airlines were operating
reviews.text: It was a nightmare - the worst flight I have ever had in my life. The flight was delayed by over 12 hours with SunExpress continuously keeping the passengers misinformed like bad weather, President' visit etc when all other airlines were operating from the same airport. The flight was delayed by over 12 hours and the SunExpress staff di not even bother visiting the airport to explain to us the reason for delay. Moreover, they have no customer service whatsover and when I did ask for the compensation claim (which was explicitly stated within the rights shared by them before the flight), they just sent an email from a no-reply address which stated that as ineligible without providing any justification whatsoever on why it was that. STAY AWAY FROM THEM IF YOU WANT TO SAVE YOUR MONEY & TIME.. THEY ARE COMPLETE FRAUDSTERS WHO WON'T EVEN HONOUR THEIR OWN WRITTEN WORD AND WILL NEVER RESPOND.
reviews.author: SalmanMasud

reviews.title: Can't fault it
reviews.text: After reading poor reviews I was a little worried but after a smooth check in, flight, and return I can honestly say I'm over the moon with the whole experience. Staff were friendly, helpful, plane was clean and the flight smooth both ways...people who complain about leg room must be over 6ft as it was no different to any other flights I've been on...definitely fly with sun express again 😀
reviews.author: Melissa S

reviews.title: Surprised
reviews.text: I was worried after reading the reviews on here but was pleasantly surprised with sun express. Check in was simple and only waited a max of 20 mins there and back. On the way to Antalya there was an hour delay but due to no fault of the plane. The flight was smooth, they gave clear instructions of the exits of the plane and what to do in case of an emergency. Walked the isle with a trolley of goods twice there and back, plenty to choose from. Even with the delay we arrived around the time we was supposed too.
reviews.author: Laurene A

reviews.title: Really disappointed !!!
reviews.text: When you have a problem, there's no one to solve this. No one can help you. We lost our money. I called many times, and no one can solve the problem. Send e-mail, no one respond. Really terrible.
reviews.author: Doede van der Werff

reviews.title: Customer service is terrible and arrogant
reviews.text: My father passed away and for this reason we wanted to cancel my mother's flight. There was a possibility to move the flight. The telephone connection was then broken. After the flight I tried to contact them several times. I was spoken to in an unfriendly tone and in addition the connection is disconnected every time. Really unbelievable how customer service tries to avoid having to refund the money. I ended up contacting them a few times via WhatsApp. Here, too, they end the conversation every time. Just after 3 minutes! I submitted a death certificate. Then they wanted another marriage certificate. My parents are not legally married, but have been living together for 30 years. I have sent proof of this. They couldn't help me. How ridiculous. It is an international airline that should be able to help everyone. Who gets married these days? The employees are unfriendly and very arrogant. I will never fly with this airline again and do not recommend it to anyone!!
reviews.author: Yasemin A

reviews.title: Very impressed with the flight
reviews.text: We recently flew from Gatwick to Antalya and were extremely impressed with the service on board, especially with what we paid. It is much better than EasyJet. Check-in and boarding were very quick and smooth. Staff were very friendly and helpful. Leg space could have been more, but you don't get it in low-cost airlines anymore unless you book a scheduled flight or upgrade your class. II have been told you can buy extra leg spaces but we didn't really need it. Overall a good service with a fairly good price.
reviews.author: Globetrotter_Zoe_

reviews.title: Alanya 2023
reviews.text: Myself and my family travelled with sun express from Edinburgh to Turkey antalya and home again, the staff on board were very good and our travel was great definitely recommend sun express and would travel again using this company
reviews.author: Donna

reviews.title: Useless staff and disrespectful.
reviews.text: I flew from Frankfort to Antalya. My experience with this airline was very disappointing. On my recent flight, we were delayed for over an hour, which caused a lot of inconvenience and frustration. When I asked the crew about the delay, they told me it is not our fault. I found this response to be unhelpful and unprofessional. As a customer, I expect the airline to take responsibility for their own delays and provide clear communication about the situation. Blaming the passengers for the delay only added insult to injury. Overall, I would not recommend this airline to others. Their lack of accountability and poor communication made for a frustrating travel experience. If you have the option to choose a different airline, I would suggest doing so.
reviews.author: Farid A

reviews.title: Disgusting service
reviews.text: I flew out on the thursday and my suitcase did not arrive when i did, the staff were useless and rude and communication is awful day 2 no sign of updates ive had to keep calling no sign of suitcase even though they said it would be on the next day flight bloody awful
reviews.author: Beauty M

reviews.title: I would have no worries flying with Sun Express again.
reviews.text: We flew from Manchester to Antalya, 2 adults and 2 older teens. Our flights were part of a package bought through Love Holidays and had 20kg hold luggage each included. We managed the flight online via the Sun Express website and managed boarding passes on the app. Check-in was simple (we couldn't specify which seats we had like with other airlines although there was an option to check-in early and pick your seat for an added fee). We used the regular online check-in and were allocated seats altogether. Dropping off the cases at the airport was straight forward and the desks were manned appropriately. Boarding was quick and the staff were great. The plane was very clean, yes basic but we didn't expect anything else due to the cheap flight price. Good communication through the flight. We had no issues with our luggage. All were in the same condition as when we left them and came out onto the carousel promptly. I would have no worries flying with Sun Express again.
reviews.author: TheCurtiss

reviews.title: Not Allowed Board Plane for Antalya
reviews.text: Checked in online...entered passport details. No problem. Issued with Boarding Card by Sun Express. NO problem. Checked through in airport check in machine..no problem. Boarding flight at departure gate and Sunexpress staff would not allow me to board flight because my passport was valid for 4.5 months. ( holiday was for 7 days ). I am not apportioning blame here. But to warn travellers to have at least 6 months left on your passport and do not rely on Sunexpress check in system or boarding cards. My wife had to travel on holiday alone.
reviews.author: Denis B

reviews.title: The most basic flight
reviews.text: The seats are not comfortable as they are small and have no headrest! The walkway is very narrow! There is no charger for mobile phones! There is no room to hold a water bottle! Our flight took longer than four hours, but they did not give us a small cup of water as everything had to be purchased!
reviews.author: From Manchester 2023

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: We were a bit nervous having read some of the reviews however we were pleasantly surprised. There were no issues with our luggage and although there was a slight delay on our outbound journey, we landed earlier than scheduled and all ran smoothly on our return journey. The aircraft was clean and pretty good for a budget airline.
reviews.author: Lily B

reviews.title: Completly Different Experience
reviews.text: This is a budget airline that actually does much better than most. Having read so many negative comments I can only disagree, at least on my flights. The airplanes were modern and clean, the service was outstanding. We were offered drinks twice during the flight, good you pay buts that is the same with any budget airline. Both our outbound and inbound flights we on time. The flight deck kept us informed at all times. I must admit I reserved the extra legroom seats (sorry). I would have no problem flying with them again.
reviews.author: Richard P

reviews.title: I must have travelled on a different airline
reviews.text: Having read the reviews on here I was dreading my flight to Antalya and back to Gatwick. I made my booking before reading the reviews. My review is for both the outbound and return flights. The aircraft were in modern and in very good condition, clean and tidy and the seats were fairly comfortable for a budget airline. The legroom was adequate for the service they provide. On both flights the cabin staff were attentive polite and were always smiling I felt welcomed and the in flight announcement were in English and Turkish. The fares were very reasonable and there were no hidden charges for baggage I had a 20 kg bag included with the fare and a small cabin bag with plenty of space to accommodate the cabin baggage. You can buy addition weight and sporting equipment at reasonable cost. Both Gatwick and Antalya bag drops were very quick and efficient. I really could not find fault with the flights. The phone app and website are not the best but I am sure they will work on that. I wish reviews reflected the true facts and not a platform to complain about minor things. Well done Sun Express I will book with you again and can recommend them as a good quality budget airline.
reviews.author: Roger

reviews.title: worst airline ever
reviews.text: We booked a holiday through a travel agency (worst agency ever Loveholidays - do not use them) for may this year. . For reasons out of our control we cannot go on holiday anymore this year, so I tried to see what can be done to cancel or change the dates for next year. This airline is only thinking of ways how to take more money from you. They don't do passenger change (WHY NOT?), they cannot change the dates more than a few months, so eventually we had to pay 1700 euros for absolutely nothing. The agent was so eager to cancel my booking, knowing that these seats will be taken by other tourists immediately...worst customer service, just a money grabbing airline
reviews.author: Octavian L

reviews.title: Worst
reviews.text: Worst travel agency. Because if them i had to pay a lot of money. I bought two ticket from them one was canceled i did not know that even. They just sent email mo sms or call. There was not have a good reason gor cancel. Customer service are wordt
reviews.author: Safiul alam M

reviews.title: Outrageous rip off airline
reviews.text: You can't change passenger names, you have to buy a whole new flight at over £400. Just another way to rip people off. It takes the click of a few keys on a computer to change a name but NO they charge for a new flight seat. Outrageous, never use Sunexpress again
reviews.author: Tina

reviews.title: Excellent airline
reviews.text: Flew in September 2022 with Sunexpress and was pleasantly surprised after hearing lots of negative reviews. The whole experience was excellent from start to finish, everything ran smoothly and I was extremely satisfied.
reviews.author: Natalie B

reviews.title: Mr Mirza
reviews.text: Training from UK 🇬🇧 to Turkey Antalya on arrival at Antalya found suitcase was split open. Logged onlincomplain none stupid question asked purchase receipts. Repair receipts etc when providing damaged suitcase photos was taken at the airport on the conwayer belt Simply refuse to compensate. I am travelling back after three months but will not use this air line in future and will not recommend to friends or family to use this airline
reviews.author: Tanveer Mirza

reviews.title: good economy airline
reviews.text: the seats are not that comfy , but the service and the cargo luggage limit (30 kg) make up for the disadvantages...
reviews.author: Yucef-G-Badr

reviews.title: First flight since COVID 2019.
reviews.text: Basically a no frills airline that was good for legroom but seats were so hard my back still aches some days after. My expectations were not high but overall a good carrier and I would fly with them again. Their online app and website could be made more efficient as it took quite a few attempts and having to chat to a customer rep. before I managed to check in online. Their check in desks were good, with polite and professional staff both at LGW and at AYT. Their cabin staff were also very good, servicing all with a smile unlike the miserable BA cabin crew! If the seats could be made more softer I think this airline beats many of its competitors.
reviews.author: Al

reviews.title: Sun Express customer service DISGUSTING experience!!
reviews.text: They damage my luggage and my case was ongoing like 10 month !!!! They always kept saying different update of my lagguage case but they were cooperating somehow untill 10 month past my case and they said oh I reported after 7 days my claim so it is automaticly rejected and they refused any compensation however report saying You should report withinn 7 days but it does not say mandotary !! I reported after my holiday 8 days after my report ?!??!? They kept me beleive I can get my compensation. They have all my document but they played a diguasting game with my for 10 month !! However I had proof of they told me they will pay my compensation at the end they hang up on me multiple times. I fly 2-3 times a year with my friends to Turkey but I never forget this customer service experience !!!!! NEVER EVER SUNEXPRESS !!!!!!
reviews.author: Roland M

reviews.title: Thw worse flight
reviews.text: The most disappointing experience was our check in: most of passengers got problems with their boarding passes. Everybody around were irritated and unhappy. As a result we were late for 20 min to board. Most of flight attendants were rude and unprofessional. Nothing was free on board: we should pay even for water and coffee but it was not a low cost flight! As we know this company is related to Lufthhanza - really a shame for such respected company as Lufthanza. Not recommended.
reviews.author: Irina
